title: Inheritance Dispute Ruling: judge voids Douglass will; elder son may get $1bn estate
summary_full: In a recent legal development, Lanzce Douglass and Stacey Douglass Boies have been found by the court to have financially taken advantage of their father, Harlan Douglass. The judge has reinstated Harlan's earlier will, raising Harley Douglass's chances of inheriting a substantial fortune. This inheritance dispute sheds light on the complexity of wealth distribution, revealing cognitive struggles that affected Harlan's financial decisions.
